snippet.title: Mr. Grin's Final Act - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4122380/Mr_Grins_Final_Act/

Thirty years ago, a tragedy closed the studio forever.
Now you're back... So is Mr. Grin.

Scavenge badges, rewire circuits, crack safes.
Explore abandoned TV sets from the 80s.
Uncover what really happened that night.
One sound and you die.

He's not only hunting you. He's directing you.
His script. Your survival.
